subject: Post-demo: Meridian pilot runbook, capacity commitments & next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@meridiansystems.com>, Jason Liu <jason.liu@meridiansystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Meridian pilot runbook, capacity commitments & next steps

Thanks for the demo time today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a shared starting point.

Call highlights:
- Use case: real-time summarization + question-answering for customer chat logs (avg. input length ~1.2k tokens, spike to 6k for attachments).
- Target latency: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 400ms for 1-2 concurrent sessions per user.
- Success criteria: qualitative accuracy on a 50-case prompt set + performance thresholds (see matrix).

Proposed evaluation plan (2-week pilot):
1) Week 0 (prep): exchange sample dataset, sign mutual action plan, reserve capacity.
2) Week 1: baseline runs (1k inference samples/day), measure latency + quality.
3) Week 2: burst/emulated production traffic, regression checks, ops handoff.

Initial capacity ask (Redwood recommendation):
- Reserve: 2 x A100-80GB (dedicated to the pilot) for baseline runs.
- Autoscale floor/ceiling: autoscale up to 6 GPUs for sustained load; allow bursts to 8 GPUs for short windows (10 minutes) to simulate peak ingest.
- Preferred runtime: FP16 for quality/throughput; provide int8 quantized variant as a low-cost option if accuracy holds.

Owners / next steps:
- Meridian: Aisha to confirm dataset + NDA items by EOD Tue.
- Redwood: Marissa will own onboarding and evaluation matrix; Neha will own infra config and autoscale policy.
- Me (Logan): coordinate kickoff and timeline.

Attachments: meridian_evaluation_matrix.xlsx (evaluation criteria + prompt set).

Please reply with any redlines or timing constraints. If that looks good, we can lock reservation and schedule a kickoff for the week of May 2.

--
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0118

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Meridian pilot runbook, capacity commitments & next steps

Great questions, Aisha — short answers up front, details below.

Cost & billing:
- Reserved 2 x A100-80GB for a 2-week pilot: estimated incremental spend ~$5,200 (reservation + usage), plus burst minutes billed at the on-demand rate per GPU-minute; yes, burst minutes are billed only for actual time used.
- We'll provide an itemized estimate in the attached PDF (redwood_capacity_options.pdf).

Autoscale mechanics and SLOs:
- Autoscale is based on queue depth + 95th percentile token latency triggers. We can publish a policy: scale +1 GPU if P95 > 300ms for >30s, scale down after <200ms for 60s.
- Bursts are allowed up to 8 GPUs for 10-minute windows; we can cap hourly burst minutes to avoid runaway spend.

Security / compliance:
- Neha (cc) will run through retention and audit log specifics; we can provide SOC2 artifacts and a short compliance runbook for the pilot.

Proposed timeline (more granular):
- Tue May 3: kickoff call, dataset handoff, finalize MPA.
- Wed May 4 - Fri May 6: baseline evals and smoke tests (Marissa owns).
- Mon May 9 - Fri May 13: load & burst testing, regression checks (Neha owns infra).
- Mon May 16: stakeholder review and optional extension decision.

Success criteria (examples to be finalized in the matrix):
- Latency: P95 <= 400ms across the sample set.
- Quality: >= 0.78 average on the human-reviewed prompt set (Meridian + Redwood reviewers).
- Reliability: no more than 2 sustained incidents affecting >5% of requests.

Next tangible steps for this week:
1) Aisha: confirm dataset delivery date (Tue) and any compliance requirements.
2) Meridian procurement: if they need a spend estimate, we'll share the PDF and a short quote.
3) Logan/Marissa: schedule kickoff for Tue May 3 (suggest 10am PT).

I'll upload the itemized pricing and capacity options now.

Attachments: redwood_capacity_options.pdf (pricing + autoscale policy examples).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Meridian pilot runbook, capacity commitments & next steps

Hi Aisha / Jason — adding the infra specifics you asked for so procurement and engineering have confidence.

Technical notes / commitments:
- Reserved baseline: 2 x NVIDIA A100-80GB with a fixed KV-cache per instance. This supports your 1.2k token median workloads with room for the occasional 6k token spike.
- Autoscale policy: we will tie scaling to model-level P95 token latency (as Marissa outlined). For your tests, set threshold at 300ms to scale up. Scale down hysteresis will be 60s.
- Burst mechanics: bursts are triggered manually or by a separate short-window autoscaler allowing up to 8 GPUs for 10-minute windows. Burst minutes are metered per GPU-minute; we will include an hourly cap (suggest 40 min/hr by default) to limit spend.
- Model profiles: default FP16 weights; we will provide a 4-bit quantized variant for cost comparison. Expect 10–15% throughput improvement with minor quality drift — we'll validate across your prompt set.
- Warmup & caching: to reach steady P95 for long contexts, run a warmup script (we'll share) that prepopulates KV caches; plan 5–10 minutes of warmup for 6k-token sequences.

Operational owners (pilot):
- Redwood infra configuration and autoscale tuning: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.com).
- Pilot coordination, evaluation matrix and stakeholder updates: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com).
- Meridian dataset and product acceptance: Aisha Khan (aisha.khan@meridiansystems.com).

I'll draft the autoscale config and post the runbook to the Drive link by Mon morning. If you confirm the dataset drop on Tue, I'll prepare the reserved capacity and the initial config so we're ready for the May 3 kickoff.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Lead, Inference Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
